name: noonlaunch
description: Launch a product on Noonlaunch, search its product directory and weekly winners, and browse 333 curated startup launch directories.

interface.longDescription:
Noonlaunch helps founders launch a product and get it discovered. It is a product launch platform and directory: makers launch products, the community votes, and the top 3 each week win a badge and a backlink.

With this plugin you can:
- Submit your own product for launch. The assistant asks for your live website URL, drafts the listing copy for you to approve, and only then submits it. The listing goes live once the Noonlaunch badge is on your site.
- Search the Noonlaunch product directory and open any product's public details.
- See a week's launch board and its top 3 winners.
- Browse 333 curated startup launch directories and communities, filtered by category and minimum domain authority.

Nothing is published from the chat. Submitting returns a private, single-use claim link, and the listing only goes live after you open it and sign in with Google. The plugin cannot edit or delete existing listings.

No account or API key is needed to connect.
defaultPrompt: Help me launch my product on Noonlaunch.
Who won on Noonlaunch last week?
Find launch directories with domain authority above 50.

positive.prompt: Who won on Noonlaunch last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get-weekly-winners with weeks_ago 1 and lists the top 3 products of the last completed week with their noonlaunch.com links.

positive.prompt: Find launch directories with domain authority above 50.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns launch directories with a domain authority of at least 50, with names and links.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the product BoastIndex on Noonlaunch.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get-product with the slug boastindex and returns its public details with a link to https://noonlaunch.com/product/boastindex.

positive.prompt: Search Noonlaunch for AI writing tools.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching approved products ordered by votes, each with a link to its Noonlaunch page, or says none were found.

positive.prompt: I want to launch my product on Noonlaunch. My site is https://example.com
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check-product first, drafts a name, tagline and description within the returned limits and shows the draft for approval, then calls submit-product and returns only the private claim link and the badge snippet for the site's footer. Nothing is published until the person claims the listing and the badge is live.

negative.prompt: Help me plan my Product Hunt launch for next Tuesday.
Write a launch tweet announcing my new note-taking app.
Delete my product listing from Noonlaunch.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or start any checkout. Products submitted through ChatGPT use the badge-based launch only.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: product submission with a private claim link, directory search, product details, weekly winners, and the launch directory list.
